mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.answer_id, i.question_id, i.answer_value, coalesce(nullif(i.question_title, ''), q.title) as question_title, coalesce(nullif(i.q_type, ''), q.q_type) as q_type from biz_survey_answer_item i left join biz_survey_question q on q.question_id = i.question_id where i.answer_id = #{answerId} order by q.sort asc nulls last, i.item_id asc

select i.item_id, i.answer_id, i.question_id, i.answer_value, coalesce(nullif(i.question_title, ''), q.title) as question_title, coalesce(nullif(i.q_type, ''), q.q_type) as q_type from biz_survey_answer_item i inner join biz_survey_answer a on a.answer_id = i.answer_id left join biz_survey_question q on q.question_id = i.question_id where a.survey_id = #{surveyId} and coalesce(a.valid_flag, '1') <> '0'

select i.item_id, i.answer_id, i.question_id, i.answer_value, coalesce(nullif(i.question_title, ''), q.title) as question_title, coalesce(nullif(i.q_type, ''), q.q_type) as q_type from biz_survey_answer_item i left join biz_survey_question q on q.question_id = i.question_id where i.answer_id in #{id} order by i.answer_id asc, q.sort asc nulls last, i.item_id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into biz_survey_answer_item (answer_id, question_id, answer_value, question_title, q_type) values

mapper.delete: delete from biz_survey_answer_item where answer_id in #{id}
delete from biz_survey_answer_item where answer_id in (select answer_id from biz_survey_answer where survey_id = #{surveyId})
